blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Open sort menu traps keyboard focus: Tab cycles inside it and Escape does not close it) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Keyboard users cannot leave the open menu without picking a sort order — WCAG 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap (Level A), 2.1.1 Keyboard. Stop intercepting Tab (let it close the menu and move focus on, per the APG menu button pattern), and handle Escape: close the menu and return focus to the trigger button. Alternatively use a native <select>, which needs none of it.
findings.title: Open sort menu traps keyboard focus: Tab cycles inside it and Escape does not close it

findings.evidence: <button ref={button} type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>
findings.recommendation: Screen reader users are told the menu is collapsed while it is open — WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value. Bind the state: aria-expanded={open}.
findings.title: Menu button always announces aria-expanded="false"
